instruction: Change the text color in all textboxes on slides 4 and 5 to red

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing text color to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0) for all textboxes on slides 4 and 5 (0-indexed: 3 and 4). Slide 4 has 7 textboxes, slide 5 has 2 textboxes. Evaluator checks that ALL text runs within each textbox have red color with 10-point RGB tolerance per channel. A textbox passes only if all its text runs have the target color. Partial credit is based on the proportion of fully-red textboxes.
